items.title: Microchip (MCHP) Stock May Be 17% Undervalued After Safety Certification
items.summary: Microchip Technology has seen its share price come under pressure in recent months, and that slide puts a sharper spotlight on whether the current valuation lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate available, the key issue is how the market price around US$57.66 relates to those projected cash flows. The stock has fallen 24.8% over the past 3 years, which makes the question of what investors are paying for its future cash streams...

items.title: Does Safety Certifications Change The Bull Case For Microchip Technology (MCHP)?
